rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the __init__ method of the class being instantiated, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: Using too many or too few arguments in a call to the `__init__` method of a class will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: Global variable is defined but not used

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: Return Inside Finally Block
rules.description: Using a Break or Return statement in a finally block causes the Try-finally block to exit, discarding the exception.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an HTTP header, possibly allowing a timing attack to infer the header's expected value.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: A regular expression that requires exponential time to match certain inputs can be a performance bottleneck, and may be vulnerable to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Detection of Error Condition Without Action
rules.description: Except doesn't do anything and has no comment

rules.cwe_name: Object Model Violation: Just One of Equals and Hashcode Defined
rules.description: Defining a hash operation without defining equality may be a mistake.
